grades.quote: When the TLB refill exception is triggered, the hardware records the old value of the IE field in the CSR.CRMD in this field. When CSR.TLBRERAIsTLBR=1, the hardware restores the value of this field to the IE field of CSR.CRMD when the ERTN instruction is executed to return from the exception handler.
grades.reason: Explains saving and restoring CRMD.IE around TLB refill exceptions, not how it combines with ECFG and ESTAT to gate pending interrupts.
